title: New Boulevard, Pension Rules, & Employee Day Off
summary:
*   Discussed and tentatively approved land acquisition for a major East 1st Street Boulevard extension, involving negotiations with property owners for rights-of-way.
*   Proposed significant amendments to the city's Retirement and Pension System, including a new six-month probationary period for incoming employees and changes to administrative rules.
*   Declared October 16, "Registration Day," a holiday for all city employees.
